app.name: Curiouskids Club
app.tagline: Our neighbourhood lending library for curious kids

home.title: Welcome to Curiouskids Club
home.intro: Browse the shelves, reserve a book and pick it up at a time that suits you.

pages.notFoundBody: We couldn't find that page. It may have moved.

errors.title: Something went wrong
errors.body: Sorry, this part of the page could not be shown. Please try again.
errors.unexpected: Something went wrong. Please try again in a moment.
errors.rateLimited: Too many requests. Please wait {{minutes}} minutes and try again.

register.intro: Create a family account to reserve books. It takes a minute.
register.name: Your name
register.passwordHint: At least 12 characters. A few random words make a good one.
register.phoneHint: Only used if we need to reach you about a pickup.
register.confirmAdultRequired: Please confirm you are 18 or older
register.acceptTerms: I accept the terms and privacy notice
register.acceptTermsRequired: Please accept the terms and privacy notice
register.checkEmail: We've sent a link to {{email}}. Open it to confirm your email address. If it doesn't arrive in a few minutes, check your spam folder.

verifyEmail.done: Your email is confirmed. Welcome to the club!
verifyEmail.invalid: This link has expired or was already used. Ask for a new one below.
verifyEmail.noToken: Open the link in the email we sent you. If you can't find it, ask for a new one.
verifyEmail.resent: If that email needs confirming, we've sent a new link. It works for 24 hours.

auth.noAccessBody: This page is for club volunteers or admins. If you think you should have access, ask an admin.

login.intro: Welcome back. Log in to reserve books and see your loans.
login.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please wait {{minutes}} minutes and try again.
login.passwordChanged: Your password has been changed. Log in with your new password.

resetPassword.requestIntro: Enter the email address you registered with and we'll send you a link to choose a new password.
resetPassword.sent: If that email has an account, we've sent a link. It works for one hour. Check your spam folder if it doesn't arrive in a few minutes.
resetPassword.chooseIntro: Choose a new password. You will be logged out on all your devices.
resetPassword.passwordHint: At least 12 characters. A few random words make a good one.
resetPassword.invalid: This link has expired or was already used. Ask for a new one below.

children.intro: Add your children so you can borrow books for them. We only keep a first name or nickname and an age band, nothing else.
children.empty: You haven't added any children yet.
children.limitReached: You have added as many children as a family can have. Remove one to add another.
children.notFound: That child has already been removed.
